name: export-customer-pdf
description: Export a customer's tax summary PDF from the billing portal. Use when the user gives a customer id and asks for that customer's tax summary.
explanation: The portal has no API. The person showed the path: open billing, search the customer id, open the tax summary, and export the PDF. The customer id changes every run. The menus do not.

steps.narration: Start on the billing home, already signed in.
The search box is the only value that changes between customers.
Open that customer's tax summary, not the invoice list.
Export writes the PDF. CSV is the wrong format.
The run is finished only when the portal confirms the download.

success: A PDF for the requested customer id was downloaded, and the page shows Download started.
